                                                                                                                                        • Host menu: L1 + R3 opens; X selects; R1/L1 scroll; Square goes back.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Read the supplied control-layout instructions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                    The archive includes common.ff, code_post_gfx.ff, a button-instructions text file and an advanced RTF guide. On the default layout, the text says to go prone and press X to open the menu. Its tactical instructions use D-pad Up for MainCFG and D-pad Down for Binds before other shortcuts. The documentation uses Xbox-style A, B, X, Y, RB and LB labels; it does not document a PS3 button mapping or file destination.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Readme controls

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Aim with L1 and use melee to open the menu.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • R1 scrolls down, L1 scrolls up and Square selects.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Melee (R3) returns or closes the menu.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • D-pad Up enables the menu's rank and prestige options without an on-screen confirmation, according to the readme.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Der Riese private-match note

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The readme says Der Riese may appear with a checkerboard preview. It describes selecting Der Riese through online search, backing out and then opening Private Match. This is a distributor note, not a hardware test result.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Build / firmware
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Separate DEX and HEN variants. DEX readme requires DEX and 720p; the HEN port's readme explicitly removes both restrictions for that port. Exact firmware, title ID and game update remain unspecified.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Choose the correct Elite Bot variant

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The DEX build's readme requires DEX and 720p display resolution.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • The HEN folder contains Zeam's port. Its edited readme says that port no longer requires DEX and supports all display resolutions. Do not apply that claim to the separate DEX build.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Keep the selected variant's EliteBot folder, configuration and EBOOT together; do not mix the DEX and HEN files.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Readme installation and configuration

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Preserve the original MW2 EBOOT. Copy the selected build's whole EliteBot folder into /dev_hdd0/tmp/ and its EBOOT into the matching MW2 game directory. The author recommends creating a fresh configuration to avoid settings left over from older versions. Optional included CFG files are placed at the USB root, with the USB in the PS3's rightmost slot, when using those CFG features.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Controls and known issues

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • In game: D-pad Up + R3 opens; Up/Down scrolls; D-pad Left selects; Circle exits submenus or the menu.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Pregame: D-pad Up + L1 opens; Square selects; L1/R1 scrolls; R3 exits.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Choose only the intended platform files

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The ZIP includes PS3/CFW and PS3/HEN EBOOT/SPRX pairs, PS3/Tactic supporting data, and a separate XBOX/tactic_mw2.xex. The Xbox executable is not a PS3 file. Keep the complete original archive, but use only the documented PS3 components for a PS3 installation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Source requirements and HEN conflict

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      About.txt identifies Tactic version 1 and states MW2 PS3 game update 1.14 with BLUS30377. It does not establish exact compatibility for its unspecified other-region claim. The archive supplies a HEN folder and the installation section mentions HEN, while the same document's compatibility section says HEN N/A. Confirm the intended HEN build before using it; the presence of a folder does not resolve that contradiction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      PS3 installation described in About.txt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      1. Preserve original filesBack up the matching MW2 EBOOT.BIN and confirm the game update, title ID and console build.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      2. Copy supporting data and the chosen PS3 pairCopy the whole PS3/Tactic folder to /dev_hdd0/tmp/. From the appropriate PS3 environment folder, copy tactic_mw2.sprx to /dev_hdd0/tmp/ and EBOOT.BIN to /dev_hdd0/game/<your title ID>/USRDIR/. Keep Xbox files separate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Controls and listed issue

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      The PS3 shortcut is D-pad Up + Square; the separate Xbox shortcut is D-pad Up + X. About.txt notes that other clients can sometimes control shots from the unfair-aim option. This is a source-reported issue, not a hardware test result.

Choose EBOOT(DEX).BIN or EBOOT(CEX-HEN).BIN for the actual console environment, rename the selected file EBOOT.BIN and place it in the matching BO1 /dev_hdd0/game/<BLES or BLUS title ID>/USRDIR/. It says to rename the supplied Evil_Nightmare_zm.sprx to Nightmare_zm.sprx in the NyTekCFW/Bo1 folder and select the CEX/HEN-labelled EBOOT for that setup. This historical source-specific instruction does not establish compatibility with other firmware versions. Separate unofficial no-shader variants are also preserved in the archive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      For CFG loading, the readme puts the whole NyTekCFW_USB folder at the USB root and identifies NyTekCFW_USB/Bo1/Loader.cfg as the custom CFG file.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   Region / title
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  BLES02166 / BLUS31527

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Choose the supplied files

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. Use one matching EBOOTThe README says to copy only the EBOOT for the installed BO3 region. The archive provides game/BLES02166/USRDIR/EBOOT.BIN and game/BLUS31527/USRDIR/EBOOT.BIN. Preserve the original executable.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  2. Choose and rename one SPRXUnder tmp/Q_CE, choose one supplied SPRX variant and rename it Q_BO3_CE.sprx as the archive marker instructs. The README recommends Only Filled In because Full Non Filled In displays many unimplemented options.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Documented controls and prerequisites

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • The README lists D-pad Left + L1 as the menu shortcut; D-pad Down toggles Air-Stuck.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Set BO3 to 720p for ESP and choose the controller L1/R1 layout for aimbot, as specified by the source.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • While changing stats, hold L1 to scroll slower or R1 to scroll faster.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • If the initial scroll bar is absent, the source says to press D-pad Up a few times. If number selectors scroll automatically, press D-pad Right once.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Beta limitations

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  The README warns that many options are missing or unimplemented and crashes are expected. It says development last occurred in early October 2020. These are source claims about this captured build, not a hardware test or a promise of later updates.

The CFW README claims testing on Rebug D-Rex 4.80.1/4.81 with Rebug Mode, warns CFW below 4.80 may be unstable and reports a soft-brick risk. Those CFW claims do not validate the separate HEN build.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Included CFW README installation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The README says to put all supplied SPRX files in hdd0/tmp and replace the EBOOT for the desired game. The CFW and HEN folders each contain two SPRX files; preserve those paired files and keep the variants separate. Match the installed title/update and preserve the original executable.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Source-specific requirements and warnings

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The CFW README reports testing on Rebug D-Rex 4.80.1 and 4.81, requests Rebug Mode and warns that CFW below 4.80 may be unstable. It also reports a soft-brick occurrence associated with a third SPRX and warns against altered redistributions. These are source claims, not verified testing or malware findings, and do not establish HEN compatibility. Controls are undocumented.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Region / title
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      IV: BLES00229 / BLUS30127 / NPEB00882 / NPUB30704; TBOGT: BLES00229_E2 / BLUS30127_E2 / NPEB00907 / NPUB30702.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Original source-post image; appearance does not establish archived-build compatibility.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      IV destinations recorded by the source

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • BLES00229 or BLUS30127: place IV/update.img in /dev_hdd0/game/<title ID>/USRDIR/.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • NPEB00882 or NPUB30704: place IV/update.img in /dev_hdd0/game/<title ID>/USRDIR/update/.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      TBOGT destination and prerequisite

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      For BLES00229_E2, BLUS30127_E2, NPEB00907 or NPUB30702, place the TBoGT script.img and script_network.img pair in /dev_hdd0/game/<title ID>/USRDIR/DLC2/DLC/common/data/cdimages/. The README explicitly also requires the modded update.img for TBOGT to work. Verify the installed title and preserve original files; no game update, exact console environment or opening controls are documented.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Included installation guide

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The guide puts update.rpf in /dev_hdd0/game/BLES01807/USRDIR and requires a modded EBOOT; it permits an already compatible one or one of the supplied variants. If using a supplied EBOOT, place it in the same USRDIR directory after matching the variant and preserving originals. For HEN/FTP transfer, the source says enable HEN and FTP first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Keep executable-specific SPRX names distinct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The CEX Extortion note requires any SPRX used with that EBOOT to be named Extortion.sprx. DEX/HEN Unrestrained notes instead specify GTA.sprx. These names apply to the selected EBOOT, not to a universally interchangeable loader. The Semjases EBOOT folder is separately labelled HEN-CEX-DEX without a corresponding naming document.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Opening shortcut

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The changelog header says Left Stick + Right Stick opens the mod loader.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          Source troubleshooting

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          The supplied guides report that certain Unrestrained protection/clear-area options can hide vehicles, prevent explosions or create session bugs. Treat those effects and the source's bypass/anti-ban claims as documentation claims, not verified protection. A bundled LibertyV Windows editor is separate from the PS3 loader; no bundled executable was run.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Region / title
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              GOTY BLES01294 / BLUS30758

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Choose the exact region and menu branch

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The archive separates BLES01294 and BLUS30758, with Demonic and jedijosh pre-modded patch0_ps3.rpf/dlcpatch0_ps3.rpf pairs for each. It also supplies GOTY loose compiled scripts/assets. Keep each region/menu distribution together. No full RPF installation destination or exact firmware/update requirement is documented here.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Documented menu controls

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Demonic Revelations: hold R2 and press R3 to open; D-pad Up/Down scrolls, X selects/toggles, Circle backs out or closes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • jedijosh Trainer: hold R1 and press D-pad Right to open or instantly close; directional pad scrolls, X selects and Circle backs out.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Bite's menu: hold L2 + Triangle to open or instantly close; D-pad Up/Down scrolls, X selects and Circle backs out.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Source-reported conflicts and required assets

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The README recommends running one menu at a time because combining Demonic and jedijosh increases crash risk. It also warns against running both custom-weapon scripts together. Template files are required for all-animal models in Demonic and can alter matchmaking pool behavior; the jedijosh prebuilt branch omits those templates. These are source reports, not tested behavior.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Loose content is not source code

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              The loose branches contain compiled CSC scripts and runtime CSF/XML/CTD assets, not a supplied C/C++ project. The archive separately contains optional custom video assets designated for the game root rather than update/RPF locations; none were played. Preserve all original files and use the branch matching the installed GOTY title.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                PS3 DEX/HEN reference branches found in the combined Rapture v2 archive. Required loader, EBOOT and raw-script files are present, but shared script verification logic and conflicting PS3 instructions prevent a verified-ready compatibility claim.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Game update
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Not specified by source
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Build / firmware
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Separate PS3 DEX and HEN EBOOT/SPRX branches are supplied. Both require the shared raw/maps/_zombiemode_load.gsc. Exact BLES title ID, game update and firmware are undocumented. The HEN README requires both SPRX files, while the top-level PS3 README says one or the other. Both remain reference/incomplete because the shared script checks the literal player name "level.hostname" before permitting menu opening.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Region / title
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                PS3 READMEs say Bles only; no complete title ID or BLUS support documented.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Reference status and source concern

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Both PS3 branches contain their named EBOOT/SPRX files and the required shared raw script, but neither is presented as verified ready. In the script, startingLobby marks a player as host only when self.name equals the literal string "level.hostname"; all other names become unverified, and monitorButtons refuses to open for unverified players. No other verification assignment occurs in that supplied script. This is a static source finding, not a console test; the original script has not been repaired.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Keep both PS3 branches visible and distinct

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • DEX branch: PS3/InfinityOps.sprx plus PS3/DEX EBOOT/EBOOT.BIN, with the shared raw/maps/_zombiemode_load.gsc.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • HEN branch: PS3/InfinityOps HEN/InfinityOps_Hen.sprx plus its HEN EBOOT/EBOOT.BIN and the shared raw script. The HEN README additionally requires the top-level PS3/InfinityOps.sprx.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Conflicting PS3 setup instructions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The top-level PS3 README says InfinityOps.sprx OR InfinityOps_HEN.sprx, while the HEN-specific README says InfinityOps.sprx AND InfinityOps_HEN.sprx. The actual HEN member is spelled InfinityOps_Hen.sprx, with different capitalization. Neither source conflict has been silently resolved or used to invent a rename/loading sequence.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Only PS3 destinations documented

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Both PS3 readmes put the SPRX files and the entire raw folder in tmp, retaining raw/maps/_zombiemode_load.gsc. They say to put EBOOT.BIN inside the installed Bles directory without a complete title ID, USRDIR destination or game update. Xbox paths and requirements have not been substituted into this PS3 guide. Preserve original executables and the original combined archive.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Controls visible in the shared script

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Opening condition uses ADS plus Melee, subject to the unresolved verification guard.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Attack scrolls forward/down and ADS scrolls back/up while the menu is open.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Use selects; Melee backs out or closes.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • These are engine input actions read from monitorButtons, not verified PlayStation button mappings or runtime behavior.
